name: @unfixed3854/pi-usage
description: A pi extension that displays active model provider subscription quota usage in the status bar. Supports z.ai (GLM) and OpenAI Codex with provider-specific quota percentages, plan levels, and reset times. Updates every 60 seconds during agent runs.
